tool: Phase 3D validation of the final L01-L56 distributed-lag outputs
declared: Definitions, references, comparison criteria and status rules below are declared BEFORE any study run and are fixed. The tool reports against them and never adjusts them, never redraws a figure, and never replaces an accepted result. Accepted fits, covariates, covariance estimators, seeds, draw counts and the MVN method are those of the accepted package configuration (config/sieccwinter_config.json, section dlm.final); conflicts between sources are reported, not silently resolved.

outputs_verified: global tests (carried along, already validated in the core run)
scope.excluded: archived L01-L59 analyses (168 models, lag-form sensitivity 216 fits, the 18 L59 bootstrap rows) stay separate and are not touched; figures are not redrawn

definitions.lag_basis: B (56 x 3): natural cubic spline basis over lags 1..56 with intercept, equal to splines::ns(1:56, df = 3, intercept = TRUE) (the basis dlnm::onebasis / crossbasis use for arglag = list(fun = 'ns', df = 3)); one interior knot at the median lag (28.5), boundary knots 1 and 56
definitions.cross_basis: CB = H B where H is the n x 56 matrix of daily exposure L01..L56 (strict complete history: a participant with any missing lag value, outcome or covariate is excluded); linear exposure-response
definitions.model: outcome ~ M2-L covariates + CB; gaussian outcomes by least squares with HC3 covariance; binary outcome by logistic maximum likelihood with model-based (inverse information) covariance; glm convergence epsilon 1e-12, maxit 200
definitions.lag_specific_effect: f(l) = (B theta)_l, theta = the three CB coefficients
definitions.cumulative_effect: C(k) = sum_{l <= k} f(l); SE(C(k)) = sqrt(1_k' (B V_theta B')[1:k, 1:k] 1_k)
definitions.pointwise_band: f(l) +- 1.96 SE(l) (normal approximation, as in the authoritative analysis); cumulative band C(k) +- 1.96 SE(C(k))
definitions.simultaneous_band: f(l) +- c SE(l), c = type-8 0.95 quantile of max_l |T_l|, T = (B z)_l / SE(l), z ~ N(0, V_theta) from draws of MASS::mvrnorm; draws 5,000; seed = 20260729 + 100 * metric_index + outcome_index (metric index over the eight configured metrics, outcome index over the three outcomes); Mersenne-Twister / Inversion / Rejection
definitions.peak: peak lag = which.max(|f(l)|) (first maximum); peak effect = f(peak lag); descriptive only, not a statistically identified critical lag
definitions.global_test: continuous: nested-model F; binary: likelihood-ratio chi-square on 3 df

documents_state: Manuscript 2809 (Methods: Distributed-lag models, equations 3, simultaneous band paragraph, dlnm 2.4.7 statement; Results: Distributed-lag associations; Figure 6 and notes) and the SI (Table S6 formula rows: distributed-lag model, global test, cumulative effect, simultaneous max-|t| band) state L01-L56, linear exposure, natural cubic spline df 3, M2-L covariates, 5,000 multivariate-normal draws, max-|t|, cumulative effect as the sum of lag-specific coefficients, peak lag as the largest absolute lag coefficient (descriptive). The documents do not state the covariance estimator, the MVN sampler, the quantile type, the seed rule, the 1.96 pointwise multiplier or the glm convergence setting.

conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.statement: the manuscript, the package configuration and the accepted run use 5,000 MVN draws; the audited L56 reconstruction (Phase 1, legacy engine, frozen as reference) used 10,000 draws
conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.handling: the final specification is verified at 5,000 draws; the Phase 1 simultaneous critical values are compared by an exact seeded recomputation at 10,000 draws; the two draw counts are never mixed, and the Monte Carlo difference between 5,000 and 10,000 draws is reported

conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.statement: the manuscript states dlnm::crossbasis (dlnm 2.4.7); the package computes the identical basis with splines::ns (the basis dlnm calls); dlnm is not installed in the validation environment
conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.handling: equality with dlnm is recorded evidence from Phase 1 (1.8e-12) and is re-tested only where dlnm is installed (otherwise NOT_TESTED); equality with splines::ns and with an independent natural-spline construction is tested here

conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.statement: the archived V1.4 engine used glm epsilon 1e-12 for the binary DLM, the superseded V1.4 package default was 1e-10 (Phase 1 finding); the package configuration uses 1e-12

the seed rule is not stated in the documents; code and the audited reconstruction use 20260729 + 100 * metric_index(1..8) + outcome_index(1..3); the Phase 1B draw-count stability file draws one long sequence and reads its first rows, which is not identical to an independent shorter call
conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.handling: exact seeded reproduction uses true calls with the declared seed and draw count; Phase 1B stability values are context only (not an exact reference)

conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.statement: covariance estimator, MVN sampler, quantile type and the 1.96 pointwise multiplier are not stated in the documents
conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.handling: taken from the accepted code and configuration; recorded here as code-defined, not document-defined

conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.statement: no original-author L56 DLM output exists; the L56 reference is an audited reconstruction produced in the Phase 1 audit with the legacy engine (siecc_fit_dlm at max_lag 56) on the audited data, cross-checked by an independent re-derivation
conflicts_and_gaps_reported_not_resolved.handling: labelled AUDITED_L56_RECONSTRUCTION in every output; agreement with it is not agreement with an original deposited result

references.file: dlm_final_summary.csv, dlm_final_lag_curves.csv, dlm_final_cumulative_curves.csv of the accepted core paper run (read only; supplied with -AcceptedRunDir)
references.use: exact reproduction of the accepted fits (9 summaries, 504 lag rows, 504 cumulative rows)
references.tolerance: exact (1e-12 abs / 1e-12 rel; the existing named set)

references.use: n, global statistic and p, q9, cumulative effect, SE and CI, peak effect
peak lag, counts of lags whose pointwise and simultaneous bands exclude zero
exact seeded reproduction of the simultaneous critical value at the audited draw count
references.tolerance: seeded (declared here: 1e-9 abs + 1e-9 rel); a larger difference is a failure of exact reproduction even if Monte Carlo consistent

references.file: computed in the run by R/dlm_verify.R (own B-spline basis, own least squares / Newton logistic fit, own HC3, own cumulative sums, own MVN draws)
references.use: lag basis, lag effects and SEs, cumulative curves, pointwise and simultaneous bands, peaks and the critical value
references.tolerance: independent (declared here: 1e-8 abs + 1e-7 rel for fitted quantities; basis space 1e-12; critical value 1e-9)
not applicable: NOT_TESTED; figures are not redrawn

references.use: equality of the package basis with dlnm
references.tolerance: 1e-12; NOT_TESTED when dlnm is not installed

accepted_fit_reproduction.rule: all numeric cells equal within the exact class; keys and record counts (9, 504, 504) must match

independent_route.binomial_tolerance_reason: glm.fit stops when the relative deviation change is below the accepted epsilon (1e-12); the model-based covariance is then evaluated at an iterate that is converged to about 1e-7 relative, so binary standard errors can differ from a fully converged Newton solution at that level (synthetic observation 2.2e-7)

tight_convergence_check.use: verification only (never exported as a result, never replaces the accepted fit): the package engine refitted with glm epsilon 1e-14 must equal the independent route at the gaussian tolerances and reproduce the independent critical value exactly (1e-9)

criteria.simultaneous_exact_seeded: EXACT seeded reproduction (same seed, draw count, quantile type, MVN method; absolute difference <= 1e-9 requires identical covariance within about 1e-12 and identical eigenvector signs) is required for: (a) the accepted run (identical engine), (b) the audited L56 reconstruction at 10,000 draws (legacy engine), (c) the independent route against the package refitted at tight convergence (binary) or directly (continuous). The cross-implementation comparison of the package at the ACCEPTED glm epsilon with the independent route is classified EXACT or MC_CONSISTENT_NOT_EXACT: a tiny covariance difference can flip an eigenvector sign and change the realised draws (not their distribution); MC_CONSISTENT_NOT_EXACT is accepted only within the Monte Carlo criteria below and with identical band-exclusion counts, and is reported as not exact

simultaneous_mc_stability.conclusion_stability: the number of lags whose simultaneous band excludes zero must be identical for the seeded 5,000-draw critical value, for every alternative seed, for the 100,000-draw critical value and for the independent-route critical value
simultaneous_mc_stability.origin: Monte Carlo standard error of the type-8 0.95 quantile of max |t| with 5,000 draws is about sqrt(0.95 x 0.05 / 5000) / 0.1 = 0.03 (density of max |t| near its 0.95 quantile about 0.1); the bounds correspond to about 4 and 6 standard errors; Phase 1B observed 10,000-draw critical values within 0.0365 absolute (about 1.5%) of 100,000-draw values

criteria.peak_lag: descriptive; equality between routes required; a near tie (second largest |f| within 1e-6 relative of the largest) is reported as a note
criteria.manuscript_concordance: reported at the rounding of the manuscript statement; a discrepancy is reported, never reconciled; not a reference

statuses.ACCEPTED_FIT_REPRODUCTION: recomputed accepted fits equal the accepted run's DLM outputs (NOT_TESTED if no accepted run supplied)
statuses.REFERENCE_COMPARISON: strict validator against the audited L56 reconstruction (estimates, discrete, critical at 10,000 draws); a required reference that is absent or incomplete FAILS
statuses.LAG_BASIS_VERIFICATION: independent natural spline basis spans the same space as the package basis; B-spline values and boundary second derivatives as declared
statuses.CURVE_VERIFICATION: lag effects, lag SEs and pointwise bands equal the independent route
statuses.CUMULATIVE_VERIFICATION: cumulative effects, SEs and bands, and the L56 cumulative effect, equal the independent route
statuses.PEAK_LAG_VERIFICATION: peak lag and peak effect equal the independent route
statuses.SIMULTANEOUS_EXACT_SEEDED: exact seeded reproduction: (a) accepted run, (b) audited reconstruction at 10,000 draws, (c) independent route against the tight-convergence package refit (binary) or the package (continuous); and the simultaneous-band formula applied with the package critical value
statuses.SIMULTANEOUS_MC_STABILITY: Monte Carlo stability criteria above, including the cross-implementation comparison of the package at the accepted epsilon with the independent route (EXACT, or MC_CONSISTENT_NOT_EXACT within the bound)
statuses.CONVERGENCE_SENSITIVITY: binary models: the package refitted at glm epsilon 1e-14 (verification only) equals the independent route; documents that differences at the accepted epsilon are due to the accepted stopping rule
statuses.MANUSCRIPT_CONCORDANCE: descriptive statements of the manuscript agree at their rounding (reported separately; REVIEW if not)
statuses.FIGURE_PROVENANCE: always NOT_TESTED: no figure reference or provenance is available and figures are not redrawn
statuses.DLNM_EQUALITY: package basis equals dlnm where installed, otherwise NOT_TESTED
statuses.SOURCE_INTEGRITY: package source unchanged during the run
statuses.rule: NOT_TESTED is never PASS. The overall exit code is 0 only if every status is PASS; 3 if every tested status passes but some are NOT_TESTED (documented); 4 if any status FAILS or is REVIEW; 1 execution failure; 2 invalid arguments.
